answer: No. Your records show lisinopril 10 mg was stopped on September 22, 2025 by Dr. Elena Marsh because it was giving you a dry cough. She switched you to losartan 50 mg once daily. Your cough was recorded as resolved at your December 2025 follow-up. The app that still lists lisinopril is most likely showing an old copy: the Apple Health export from March 2025 was made before the change and still shows it as active. Lisinopril is also on your allergy/intolerance list for the cough. Losartan is already on your current medication lists, and taking lisinopril together with it is generally avoided. Please don't restart lisinopril. If the app is your own list, ask your clinic to confirm your current medicines, and remove lisinopril from the app.
